name: echoswarm-mobile
description: EchoSwarm native sensor app (iOS + Android) built with Capacitor from the shared web code.

scripts.sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
